zh-CN.app.title: IFC 合规审计工作台
zh-CN.app.metaTitle: IFC 合规审计工作台 · 研究工具
zh-CN.app.headline: 从条文到构件，每一步都有证据。
zh-CN.app.disclaimer: 研究与教学工具 · 不用于建筑审批、官方认证或法律意见
zh-CN.rules.heading: 规则目录
zh-CN.rules.IBC2021-1010.1.1-WIDTH.title: 疏散门最小净宽
zh-CN.rules.IBC2021-1010.1.1-HEIGHT.title: 疏散门最小净高
zh-CN.rules.IBC2021-1003.2-EGRESS-HEIGHT.title: 疏散空间最小净高
zh-CN.rules.IBC2021-1010.1.1-WIDTH.interpretat: 读取门构件的受控净开口宽度属性，并以毫米和阈值比较。
zh-CN.rules.IBC2021-1010.1.1-HEIGHT.interpreta: 读取门构件的受控净开口高度属性，并以毫米和阈值比较。
zh-CN.rules.IBC2021-1003.2-EGRESS-HEIGHT.inter: 从世界坐标三角网格的 Z 向包围盒计算受控正交空间高度。
zh-CN.ids.kicker: 信息质量 ≠ 设计合规
zh-CN.ids.heading: IDS 可检查性
zh-CN.ids.purpose: IDS 只验证所需 IFC 信息是否存在；法规阈值由独立的确定性检查器判定。
zh-CN.ids.IDS-DOOR-CLEAR-WIDTH: 门构件提供净开口宽度
zh-CN.ids.IDS-DOOR-CLEAR-HEIGHT: 门构件提供净开口高度
zh-CN.ids.IDS-EGRESS-SPACE-GEOMETRY: 空间构件提供几何表示
zh-CN.viewer.heading: 构件状态视图
zh-CN.viewer.canvas: 可旋转和点击选择的 IFC 三维构件视图
zh-CN.viewer.hint: 拖动旋转 · 滚轮缩放 · 点击构件
zh-CN.viewer.empty: 当前状态筛选没有构件
zh-CN.viewer.search: 搜索 GlobalId、名称、类别或属性
zh-CN.viewer.measureHint: 依次点击两个构件，测量其包围盒中心距离。
zh-CN.viewer.viewSaved: 视点已写入当前 URL 和本地存储。
zh-CN.viewer.noSavedView: 当前 URL 或本地存储中没有可恢复的视点。
zh-CN.evidence.heading: 判定证据
zh-CN.evidence.empty: 在结果表或三维视图中选择一个与当前规则相关的构件。
zh-CN.evidence.reason.PASS: 已取得所需信息，确定性测量达到或超过阈值。
zh-CN.evidence.reason.FAIL: 已取得所需信息，确定性测量低于阈值。
zh-CN.evidence.reason.NOT_APPLICABLE: IFC 适用性数据明确表明该规则不适用于此构件。
zh-CN.evidence.reason.NOT_CHECKABLE: 缺少所需信息或无法可靠测量；这不是设计不合规的证据。
zh-CN.evidence.reason.MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: 自动化证据不足，需要具备资质的人员复核。
zh-CN.results.heading: 检查结果
zh-CN.graph.heading: 局部关系图
zh-CN.graph.note: 只显示选中对象的局部关系
zh-CN.graph.aria: 规则、构件、结果和条文的局部关系图
zh-CN.query.kicker: 自然语言 → 校验 DSL → 确定性证据
zh-CN.query.heading: 审计查询
zh-CN.query.note: 核心查询在本机解析和执行，不调用 LLM，也不生成 SQL。
zh-CN.query.label: 用中文或英文提问
zh-CN.query.placeholder: 例如：哪些门没有通过净宽规则？
zh-CN.query.empty: 输入问题后，解析意图、筛选条件和证据会显示在这里。
zh-CN.query.noRows: 没有执行查询或没有命中结果。
zh-CN.query.matched: 确定性查询命中 {total} 条，显示 {returned} 条。
zh-CN.query.context: 当前规则和构件会作为受控查询上下文。
zh-CN.query.warning.NO_STRUCTURED_FILTERS: 未识别明确的规则、构件、状态或类别；查询没有执行。
zh-CN.query.warning.ELEMENT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED: 解释原因需要先选择一个构件。
zh-CN.query.warning.UNKNOWN_RULE_CONTEXT: 当前规则不在已发布规则目录中。
zh-CN.query.warning.UNKNOWN_ELEMENT_CONTEXT: 当前构件不在已加载模型中。
zh-CN.query.warning.UNKNOWN_STATUS: 结构化查询包含未知状态。
zh-CN.runs.heading: 运行历史
zh-CN.runs.note: 每次运行有唯一运行号；相同输入保留同一确定性执行号。
zh-CN.runs.empty: 尚无已保存运行。点击“重新检查”创建第一条审计记录。
zh-CN.toast.completed: 检查完成：{count} 条结果，运行号 {runId}
zh-CN.health.summary: {rules} 条规则 · {elements} 个构件 · SQLite v{schema}

en.app.title: IFC compliance audit workbench
en.app.metaTitle: IFC compliance audit workbench · Research tool
en.app.headline: Every step from clause to element carries evidence.
en.app.disclaimer: Research and teaching tool · Not for permitting, official certification, or legal advice
en.rules.heading: Rule catalog
en.rules.IBC2021-1010.1.1-WIDTH.title: Minimum egress door clear width
en.rules.IBC2021-1010.1.1-HEIGHT.title: Minimum egress door clear height
en.rules.IBC2021-1003.2-EGRESS-HEIGHT.title: Minimum egress space clear height
en.rules.IBC2021-1010.1.1-WIDTH.interpretat: Read the controlled clear-opening width property and compare it with the millimetre threshold.
en.rules.IBC2021-1010.1.1-HEIGHT.interpreta: Read the controlled clear-opening height property and compare it with the millimetre threshold.
en.rules.IBC2021-1003.2-EGRESS-HEIGHT.inter: Compute controlled orthogonal space height from the world-coordinate mesh Z bounding box.
en.ids.heading: IDS checkability
en.ids.purpose: IDS verifies that required IFC information exists; a separate deterministic checker evaluates regulatory thresholds.
en.ids.IDS-DOOR-CLEAR-WIDTH: Doors provide a clear opening width
en.ids.IDS-DOOR-CLEAR-HEIGHT: Doors provide a clear opening height
en.viewer.heading: Element status view
en.viewer.canvas: Rotatable IFC 3D element view with selection
en.viewer.hint: Drag to orbit · Wheel to zoom · Click an element
en.viewer.empty: No elements match the active status filters
en.viewer.search: Search GlobalId, name, class, or property
en.viewer.measureHint: Select two elements to measure the distance between their bounding-box centres.
en.viewer.viewSaved: The viewpoint was saved to the current URL and local storage.
en.viewer.noSavedView: No restorable viewpoint was found in the URL or local storage.
en.evidence.heading: Decision evidence
en.evidence.empty: Select an element in the results table or 3D view that relates to the current rule.
en.evidence.reason.PASS: Required information was available and the deterministic measurement met or exceeded the threshold.
en.evidence.reason.FAIL: Required information was available and the deterministic measurement was below the threshold.
en.evidence.reason.NOT_APPLICABLE: IFC applicability data explicitly shows that this rule does not apply to the element.
en.evidence.reason.NOT_CHECKABLE: Required information is missing or cannot be measured reliably; this is not evidence of design non-compliance.
en.evidence.reason.MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Automated evidence is insufficient and qualified human review is required.
en.results.heading: Check results
en.graph.heading: Local relationship graph
en.graph.note: Only the selected object's local relationships are shown
en.graph.aria: Local relationship graph of rules, elements, results, and clauses
en.query.kicker: Natural language → validated DSL → deterministic evidence
en.query.heading: Audit query
en.query.note: Core queries are parsed and executed locally without an LLM or generated SQL.
en.query.label: Ask in Chinese or English
en.query.placeholder: For example: Which doors failed the clear width rule?
en.query.empty: Enter a question to see the parsed intent, filters, and evidence.
en.query.noRows: The query was not executed or no results matched.
en.query.matched: The deterministic query matched {total} results and returned {returned}.
en.query.context: The current rule and element are supplied as controlled query context.
en.query.warning.NO_STRUCTURED_FILTERS: No specific rule, element, status, or class was recognized, so the query was not executed.
en.query.warning.ELEMENT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED: Select an element before asking for an explanation.
en.query.warning.UNKNOWN_RULE_CONTEXT: The current rule is not in the published catalog.
en.query.warning.UNKNOWN_ELEMENT_CONTEXT: The current element is not in the loaded model.
en.query.warning.UNKNOWN_STATUS: The structured query contains an unknown status.
en.runs.heading: Run history
en.runs.note: Every run has a unique run ID; identical inputs retain the same deterministic execution ID.
en.runs.empty: No saved runs yet. Select “Run checks” to create the first audit record.
